item.title: Team Cherry sets 'Cherry Time' showcase for November 27 with a Silksong: Sea of Sorrow update
item.description: The Hollow Knight studio will stream announcements on Friday, including news on Silksong's free expansion, which was promised for 2026.

item.title: PlayStation Plus December games: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 and Amnesia: The Bunker
item.description: Sony's three Monthly Games for December can be claimed from December 1 to January 4. November's lineup leaves on November 30.

item.title: EA Sports FC 27 brings back late commentator John Motson with an AI-recreated voice
item.description: An FC 27 update adds the BBC's 'Motty' as an optional commentator, built from his old recordings and AI. His family backs it; some fans call it bleak.

item.title: Monster Hunter Rise is now on iOS and Android through Netflix Games
item.description: Capcom's 2021 hunting game is free for Netflix subscribers on phones and tablets, with touch controls and former DLC quests included.

item.title: GTA VI has no story mission replay, so players are leaning on its 15 save slots
item.description: The pause-menu replay option from GTA IV's expansion and GTA V is gone, along with gold-medal challenges. Manual saves are the only way back.

item.title: Sony says GTA VI is the biggest launch in PlayStation history, with 39 million players on PS5
item.description: Sony's own figures put GTA VI at more than 39 million unique PS5 players, a PlayStation concurrent-player record and 683 million hours played in its opening days.

item.title: CD Projekt says Witcher 4 is planned for 2028 and Cyberpunk 2 is making good progress
item.description: On its Q3 earnings call, CD Projekt compared the jump to Witcher 4 with the jump from GTA 5 to GTA 6, and said it wants shorter gaps between its RPGs.

item.title: Lords of the Fallen II slips to April 2027, with an exact date coming in December
item.description: CI Games' CEO says the soulslike sequel now launches in April 2027. It's the game's second delay, after an earlier move to the first quarter of 2027.

item.title: Capcom is shutting down Exoprimal, with servers closing in September 2027
item.description: Capcom's online dinosaur shooter will be removed from sale on March 30, 2027, and become unplayable when its servers go offline on September 29, 2027.

item.title: GTA VI tops the UK boxed chart even though the box has no disc
item.description: GTA VI's code-in-a-box edition entered the UK physical chart at No. 1, pushing the Ocarina of Time remake down to third, as Black Friday deals lifted older PS5 games.

item.title: Nioh 3's final DLC arrives early on December 17, and the series comes to Xbox in January
item.description: Koei Tecmo moved Nioh 3's Bloody Insurrection DLC up from February to December 17, and Nioh 3 Complete Edition launches on Xbox Series X|S on January 28.

item.title: PlayStation creator Ken Kutaragi says console prices are not healthy and consoles may not be needed
item.description: In an interview with The Game Business, Kutaragi blamed costly graphics hardware and RAM shortages for high prices, and floated a lightweight platform that isn't a console or phone.

item.title: Mario Kart World update 1.9.0 adds eight tracks, all sequels to classic courses
item.description: Fans have nicknamed Mario Kart World's latest Switch 2 patch the update of 2s: its eight new tracks are all second versions of existing courses, plus two Knockout Tour routes.

item.title: GTA VI's first patch fixes broken autosaves, stuck weather and missing phone calls
item.description: Update 1.002.002 now has a list of fixes attached, led by the autosave bug that cost some players progress after launch.

item.title: Epic drops Blueprints from Unreal Engine 6 and bets on Verse and AI
item.description: UE6 will launch without Blueprints or the Actor Gameplay Framework, reversing Epic's June plan to keep both alongside the new tools for a while.

item.title: GTA VI leaker Arion Kurtaj is released with a five-year order limiting his online activity
item.description: A week after pleading guilty, the hacker behind the 2022 Rockstar leak was released on licence with a ban on Telegram and Discord.

item.title: Activision job listing names Banjo-Kazooie among its franchises
item.description: A posting for a project manager on 'emerging franchises' lists Banjo-Kazooie and mentions a premium console and PC game, fuelling talk of a revival.

item.title: Shinji Mikami says he sometimes wishes AI would disappear, but uses it anyway
item.description: At G-STAR in South Korea, the Resident Evil creator and Shift Up's Kim Hyung-tae discussed how they use AI and where they draw the line.

item.title: Rockstar puts GTA VI's day-one retail sales at $3.79 billion
item.description: Take-Two's own estimate, filed with US regulators, calls it the biggest entertainment launch ever and adds a record 32.5 million units sold before release.

item.title: GTA VI's Metacritic user score sinks to 5.6 as fans start review-bombing Zelda
item.description: Thousands of zero scores have hit GTA VI's user page, and some GTA fans have retaliated against Ocarina of Time, which held Metacritic's top user score.

item.title: GTA VI gets its first post-launch patch, with no patch notes
item.description: Update 1.002.002 is rolling out in stages on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar hasn't said what it changes.

item.title: Hacker group Cyberleek claims to be leaking a GTA VI development build
item.description: The group says it has released every file from a November Xbox build except the executable, which it is holding back on a countdown. Rockstar hasn't commented.

item.title: Expedition 33's former lead writer backs the Rockstar union push
item.description: Jennifer Svedberg-Yen says layoff fears at Rockstar after GTA VI's record launch show developers don't share fairly in the value they create.

item.title: Ubisoft posts a €254.5 million half-year loss and spins out a generative AI studio
item.description: Net bookings fell 16.5% in the six months to September, headcount dropped by about 1,100, and Ubisoft confirmed Motherbrain as a dedicated subsidiary for AI in gameplay.

item.title: GTA VI's Japanese version tones down nudity and blood
item.description: Players in Japan found swimsuits in the shower, less gore and no way to turn it back up. Rockstar did not announce the changes ahead of launch.

item.title: Digital Foundry doubts GTA VI could run on Switch 2
item.description: After testing the launch versions, Digital Foundry says a Switch 2 port looks extremely unlikely, with the game's CPU demands already pinning PS5 Pro to 30fps.

item.title: Deltarune Chapter 6 is playable start to finish, and Chapter 7 work has begun
item.description: Toby Fox's fall newsletter says Chapter 6 is a structurally complete draft heading into localization, though some scenes still need work before full testing.

item.title: Ocarina of Time stays No. 1 in Japan as Metaphor: ReFantazio debuts on Switch 2
item.description: The Switch 2 Zelda remake sold another 86,097 boxed copies in Japan in its second full week, while Switch 2 outsold every other console combined.

item.title: GTA VI sold an estimated 24.6 million copies by the end of launch day, Sensor Tower says
item.description: The analytics firm puts Rockstar's first-day haul at roughly $2.36 billion including preorders, about three times GTA V's 2013 opening. Take-Two hasn't confirmed any numbers yet.

item.title: GTA VI breaks the all-time streaming record for a game launch
item.description: Streams Charts tracked a combined peak of more than 6 million concurrent viewers across YouTube, Twitch and Kick, smashing Valorant's 2020 beta record several times over.
